**Finding: compliant (at fallback)** — Rule ASSIGN, Sections 18.9–18.10 (p0785–p0788).

- **Ono's position is protected:** Section 18.9 is symmetrical and expressly permits either Party — including Ono — to assign without consent to an acquirer of substantially all of its business or assets by merger or acquisition, so the walk-away scenario (blanket prohibition without an M&A carve-out) does not arise.
- **Affiliate assignments** require the other Party's consent, but subject to a "not to be unreasonably withheld or delayed" standard, which lands the clause on the fallback position rather than the preferred consent-free affiliate right. The tax-consequences proviso is mutual and narrow.
- **No change-of-control exposure for us:** the only CoC mechanics (Section 18.10 firewalls, Section 4.5(b) exclusivity sunset) trigger on a Change in Control of *Array*, not Ono. Array has no termination, re-pricing or restriction right on an Ono change of control, and there is no "deemed an assignment" trigger.
- **Noted, not redlined:** no express bar on Array assigning to an Ono competitor, and consent is needed for intra-group assignments — minor sub-elements short of preferred.

No redline proposed.
